verdict.rationale: Wrike's own docs say it lets teams break goals into actionable tasks and assign resources, and it advertises task management through its API and natural-language interfaces. That covers creating and assigning tasks. Due dates are only implied by 'project schedules', not stated outright. missing for 10: explicit documentation of setting per-task due dates, explicit assignment of tasks to individual teammates (vs. 'resources'), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Break large goals into actionable tasks, assign resources, attach files and view project schedules at a glance.
Manage tasks, query projects, and automate workflows through natural language.
